protected_action_policy: A source taxonomy label never authorizes a protected write. freeze_card and create_dispute require explicit utterance-level action semantics and the existing deterministic confirmation controls.

future_capability_gaps.note: The external taxonomy reveals delivery, issuance, activation, linking, and wallet-management needs; it does not authorize adding these capabilities.
SentinelVoice has no top-up product or tool surface.
SentinelVoice does not initiate, cancel, trace, or troubleshoot transfers or manage beneficiaries.
Some utterances may be near transaction lookup, but ATM troubleshooting and remedies remain product gaps.
Refund initiation and tracing are distinct from the existing protected dispute action.
